dedupe_keys.name: lacs de retenues collinaires du sage nrg

description: Lacs de retenues collinaires du SAGE NRG is a dataset listed in Gers-OpenData open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by SAGE NRG. Lacs de retenues collinaires (représentation surfacique) hors retenues structurantes et plans d'eau inférieurs à 1000 m² sur le périmètre du SAGE Neste et Rivières de Gascogne issus de l'inventaire des plans d'eau réalisé par l'Agence Française de la Biodiversité (auj. OFB) en 2018 à l'échelle du bassin Adour-Garonne. Coverage: Gers. The portal files it under Développement durable. The portal shows 3,592 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2024-01-02 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-gers-fr-portal.
